adjudication.rationale: In EventManager.ts createAllCalendarEvents, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` only calls `createEvent` when a `credential` is found either in `this.calendarCredentials` or via the Prisma `findUnique` fetch. If neither lookup yields a usable credential (e.g., dangling/deleted credentialId or missing `app.slug` so the credential object isn’t constructed), the code simply falls through without pushing any failed `EventResult`, warning, or error for that destination—i.e., the destination is silently skipped (`if (credential) { ... createdEvents.push(...) }` with no else). This matches the finding that bookings could proceed with missing calendar events without surfacing a warning/result.
